_comment: Copy to the root of the firmware repository as amygdala-ci.json. Every key is optional; these are the defaults, with notes. Unknown keys fail the run so a typo cannot silently disable a gate.
_exclude: Extra vendored or generated directory names to skip, on top of the built-in list (mtb_shared, libs, deps, third_party, build, ...). The output directory is always skipped.
_layers: Path prefixes that are driver / HAL / BSP code (lower) and application code (upper), for the layering check when the directory names do not make it obvious. Example: {"lower": ["source/drivers/"], "upper": ["source/app/"]}.
_compile_db: Path to compile_commands.json, relative to the root, so clang-tidy can run.
_tools: Static tools to run, e.g. ["cppcheck", "lizard"]. null runs everything that is installed.
_osv: send: true is the ONLY setting that lets data leave the runner: the public repository URL and tag of each third-party component go to api.osv.dev. Nothing else is sent. deps adds components the manifests do not list, as URL@TAG.
_licences: run_scancode runs ScanCode Toolkit if it is installed. maps lists linker map files that prove what is linked into the image. confirmed_components points at the confirmed_components.json a reviewer wrote with amygdala:oss; the sbom step is skipped without it, because an SBOM is never guessed.
_baseline: Committed file of accepted leads. Gates fail only on items that are not in it. Create or refresh it with `amygdala_ci.py baseline` after deliberately accepting the current state, and say why in the commit message. Without a baseline every item counts as new.

_gates.required_tools: Tool names that must have run, otherwise the build fails. ["lizard"] is a good minimum: it is a pure-Python install and feeds the Maintainability section.
_gates.hotspot_rules: Pattern rules from hotspots.py whose NEW hits fail the build. The default set is the high-signal one: embedded private keys and passwords, TLS verification off, image validation off, sample signing keys, blocking calls inside an interrupt handler.
_gates.static_min_tools: A NEW line flagged by this many independent analysers fails. 0 disables.
_gates.static_errors: A NEW analyser lead rated error (not warning) fails.
_gates.new_functions_over_thresholds: A NEW function over lizard's thresholds (complexity > 15, > 100 lines, > 5 parameters) fails.
_gates.maintainability_rating: Fail when the whole-codebase band is this bad or worse: "poor", "fair", or null to disable. This gate is absolute, not baseline-relative.
_gates.vulnerabilities: A NEW published advisory for a third-party component fails. Only evaluated when osv.send is true.
_gates.licence_families: A NEW third-party component whose most restrictive licence family is listed fails. Families: strong (GPL), network (AGPL / SSPL), weak (LGPL / MPL), nc (non-commercial), restricted, proprietary, permissive, public-domain, none-found, unknown.
